Get a clear, close-up view for makeup application or shaving—without wall mounting in Mediterranean Blue, which presents a deep, sophisticated blue with subtle purple undertones, evoking the rich depths of coastal waters for a bold yet refined statement. This freestanding make-up mirror features double-faced 8-inch mirror glass with 2X magnification on one side and a regular 1X mirror on the other, so you can switch from detail work to an all-around check in seconds.

Highlights:
- Mediterranean Blue transforms this essential into a conversation piece
- Choose from 25 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Place it anywhere on the vanity: freestanding design with a heavy solid brass base to help prevent tipping
- Protect countertops and vanities: felt pad on the base helps prevent scratching
- Coordinate with your bath: part of the make-up mirrors collection and offered in multiple designer finish options

Specs & Installation:
- Product type: freestanding, double-sided make-up mirror
- Mirror: 8-inch diameter double-faced mirror glass; 2X magnification on one side and 1X on the other
- Material: brass construction (solid brass)
- Dimensions (L x H x W): 10.5 x 56–68 x 10.5 inches (adjustable height)
- Product weight: 13.6 lb
- Assembly: some assembly required
- Included: make-up mirror
